evidence.quote: A near-real-time relay to monitoring stations on the ground would allow marine and conservation scientists to more accurately predict and react to coral bleaching events.
Coral reefs, specifically the Great Barrier Reef, would immensely benefit from dedicated satellite monitoring.

criteria.reasoning: Clear rationale, users and need are identified with references. However, formal mission objectives, requirements and performance details are not specified, so it is strong Adequate rather than Accomplished.

evidence.quote: Project work will be divided into weeks via a Gantt Chart.
Completed stages are gold. Incomplete stages are blue. Deadlines are indicated by red lines.

criteria.reasoning: Gantt chart and task descriptions make the plan feasible and linked to launch, orbit, ground and comms work. It lacks contingency provisions and deeper justification, so it is not fully Accomplished.
Some preliminary work is evident through research and STK tutorials, but no technical results, calculations or design interpretation are presented. This fits minor work completed.

evidence.quote: Coral reefs harbour some of the most diverse species of life on the planet

criteria.reasoning: Report is well structured, readable and consistently formatted. The Gantt figure is clear and footnotes match in-text markers, though references are informal URLs and the figure lacks a formal caption.

technical_issues.issue: No formal mission objectives, requirements, or performance metrics such as resolution, revisit, latency or coverage.
No actual orbit, launch or space-segment design calculations; these are only planned tasks.
Preliminary progress is limited to reading and STK tutorials; no technical results or interpretation are shown.
Gantt chart lacks contingency, dependencies and explanation of grey cells; only one deadline line is evident.
Sources are bare URLs/footnotes rather than full citations; several links are not cited in the text.
Acronyms COEs and AOEs are undefined, and no sensor or data-relay architecture is specified.
Bathymetry and thermal-stress monitoring are proposed without instrument or data-product requirements.

overall: The report has a clear, well-referenced mission rationale and a feasible Gantt plan, but preliminary technical work is minimal: no design calculations, orbit/launch results, or formal requirements. Presentation is good; references are informal. C1/C2 adequate, C3 weak, C4 accomplished-low.
